subject: Request: subprocessor visibility + temporary access window for Logflow incident
messages:
From: A. Patel <ash.patel@logflow.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Logflow Procurement <procurement@logflow.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2024 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary access window + subprocessor roster for incident triage

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for standing up a channel. We have a live triage for a customer-impacting ingestion lag that appears to originate in the Logflow agent chain. Security is asking for two items we need quickly to complete root cause analysis and to confirm no customer data left the intended processing corridor: 

1) A current list of Redwood subprocessors (names, countries of processing, and brief role) for services involved in request routing and telemetry.
2) A limited temporary access window (API key or timeboxed SFTP dump) to a tokenized telemetry slice (30m window) from yesterday so our engineers can compare traces.

We appreciate the sensitivity — we only need a tightly-scoped, auditable access path (preferably pre-signed S3 link or temporary API key with read-only logs) and a signed attestation that the access will be ephemeral and logged. Can your team provide an internal contact for legal/process and a proposed time window?

Goal is to avoid escalation. Procurement is cc'd for any minimal contract or addendum required.

Regards,
Amit Patel
Security Operations
Logflow Inc.

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2024 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary access window + subprocessor roster for incident triage

Team — forwarding Logflow's ask. Action items I want triaged today: 

- Kimberly: legal needs a one-paragraph DPA addendum / attestation template that permits a timeboxed, auditable access window and confirms no data export beyond their engineers. They asked for "signed attestation"; suggest a short addendum and a DocuSign link.
- Jonas: security/infra to propose the technical access mechanism. My preference is: pre-signed, time-limited S3 URL to a tokenized 30m logs slice + IAM role with CloudTrail logging enabled. If S3 not possible, a one-off read-only API key with immediate revocation after retrieval. Also include steps for canary validation and rollback plan.
- Naomi: compile the subprocessor roster (minimal fields: name, country, role, data path) for the routing/telemetry chain and mark any that perform cross-border transfers. Put the roster into the shared drive link and attach here.

Timeline: Logflow needs a proposed window by EOD PT today; they are in triage and procurement is waiting on the contract note. I know this is tight — please call out any blockers.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jul 2024 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary access window + subprocessor roster for incident triage

On Thu, Jul 11, 2024 at 09:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Logflow's ask. Action items I want triaged today:

We can support this with the following technical constraints and recommended controls: 

- Data extract: We will generate a tokenized, redacted export (PII replaced with stable pseudonyms) for the 30-minute window. This will be written to a pre-signed S3 object in our audit bucket. Pre-signed URL TTL: 6 hours max.
- Access model: Create a time-limited IAM role for Logflow's AWS account (if they have one) with an assume-role policy + CloudTrail enabled for assume-role events. If cross-account is not acceptable, provide pre-signed S3 URL + access log capture.
- Canary & rollback: Before handing over, we'll run a canary ingestion to an internal staging account with the same tokenization profile to confirm no downstream exports. If any unexpected schema or tokenization failures surface, we will revoke access immediately and provide a snapshot of the rollback actions.
- Evidence: We can provide a signed log export (CloudTrail + access logs) and a short signed attestation (see template idea below).

Blockers: If procurement requires a full DPA amendment rather than a short addendum, it will slow this beyond EOD. Kimberly — can you prepare a 1-paragraph attestation + DocuSign route? Naomi — I will need the subprocessor roster by 12:30 PT so I can highlight routing components (edge proxies, telemetry collectors, enrichment services).

-Jonas
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: A. Patel <ash.patel@logflow.com>, Logflow Procurement <procurement@logflow.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2024 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: temporary access window + subprocessor roster for incident triage

Amit — quick update and proposal: 

1) Subprocessor roster: attached (access_matrix.xlsx). It lists the minimal fields you requested (name / country / role / transfer note). For the immediate triage chain: EdgeProxy Co. (US) — routing; TelemetryKit (IE) — metrics aggregation (tokenized); StreamSafe (US) — short-term buffering. We flagged TelemetryKit as cross-border (IE -> US) in the notes.

2) Access window & technical plan: Jonas will produce the tokenized 30m slice and put it in a pre-signed S3 object (6-hour link). We will enable CloudTrail + S3 access logs and provide those as part of the evidence package. If you can accept the pre-signed URL plus signed attestation, we can avoid a full DPA amendment and complete this today.

3) DPA addendum: Kimberly attached a one-paragraph attestation draft (dpa_addendum_draft.pdf) and a DocuSign route we can use for signature. If Logflow signs the attestation, that satisfies procurement for this scoped access. If procurement requires broader contractual changes, we will need additional review time.

Proposed window: Fri Jul 12, 2024 20:00 - 22:00 UTC (we will generate the export after a final confirmation call). Please reply with signoff or counters by 18:00 UTC and we will schedule a 20-minute handoff call.

If procurement signs the attestation now, we will attach the DocuSign envelope and provide the pre-signed URL immediately after signature completes.

Next steps for internal team: Jonas — start the export pipeline and prepare canary steps. Kimberly — ready DocuSign and final attestation text. Naomi — verify roster details & mark the telemetry processors that perform cross-border steps.

Thanks everyone — hoping this keeps things moving without expanding contractual scope.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- access_matrix.xlsx (subprocessor roster, minimal fields)
- dpa_addendum_draft.pdf (one-paragraph attestation + signature block)
